setting: same wooden family house during one quiet morning; individual actions remain in their correct separate rooms

sentences.english: In the morning, I woke up earliest in my family.
sentences.japanese: ある朝、家族の中でいちばん早く目が覚めました。

sentences.english: To not wake up the others, I walked through the house very quietly.
sentences.japanese: みんなを起こさないように、そーっと家の中を歩きました。

sentences.english: I opened the door at the entrance, picked up the newspaper, and watched the morning light on the floor.
sentences.japanese: 玄関の扉を開けて新聞を取って、床に射す朝の光をしばらく見つめていました。

sentences.english: In the hall, the carpet gently took my footsteps.
sentences.japanese: 廊下では、カーペットがわたしの足音をやさしく吸い込んでくれます。

sentences.english: In front of the mirror, I looked at my face and smiled.
sentences.japanese: 鏡の前に立って、自分の顔を見て、にっこり笑いました。

sentences.english: My father's car key was always placed in a small basket at the entrance.
sentences.japanese: 父の車のキーは、玄関の小さなカゴの中にいつも置かれています。

sentences.english: Next to it, there was an old box full of colorful stamps.
sentences.japanese: そのそばには、いろんな色の切手がいっぱい入った古い箱がありました。

sentences.english: The lamp in the living room was still softly on.
sentences.japanese: リビングのランプは、まだほんのりと灯っていました。

sentences.english: Perhaps my mother fell asleep while reading a book last night.
sentences.japanese: 昨日の夜、母は本を読みながら眠ってしまったのかもしれません。

sentences.english: In the kitchen, the cups on the shelf shone in the morning sun.
sentences.japanese: 台所では、棚のカップが朝日を浴びて光っていました。

sentences.english: I took a cup and filled it with cold water.
sentences.japanese: わたしはカップを一つ取って、冷たい水を注ぎました。

sentences.english: When I went outside, a little bird was sitting on the roof of our house.
sentences.japanese: 外に出てみると、小さな鳥が家の屋根にとまっていました。

sentences.english: When I opened the garage door a little, my father's bicycle was standing quietly, as if saying good morning.
sentences.japanese: ガレージの扉を少し開けると、父の自転車が「おはよう」と言うように、静かに立っていました。
